title: 3 SPEED AUTO. TRANS.-CONTROL SWITCH, WIRING & ADJUSTMENT
summary: Automatic-transmission detent (kickdown/downshift) switch on the accelerator pedal rod support under the dash (RPO M40 Turbo Hydra-Matic). The switch is screwed to a bracket, and the bracket is bolted with a washer to the accelerator pedal rod support; the engine wiring harness plugs into the switch and passes through a firewall grommet. View A shows the 4.40 in. gauged dimension of the accelerator cable at the carburetor lever used for adjustment.

fastening.note: View B: screw [3] holds the switch [2] to the bracket.
View B: screw [4] with washer [5] holds the bracket [6] to the accelerator pedal rod support (support's own attaching parts: see UPC 6).
